description: Hanuman is a Hindu god and an ardent devotee of Rama. He is a central Character in the Hindu epic Ramayana and its various versions. Several texts also present him as an incarnation of Lord Shiva. He is the son of Anjana and Kesari and is also described as the son of Vayu, who according to several stories, played a role in his birth.The Sanskrit texts mention several legends about how Hanuman got his name. One legend is that Indra, the king of the deities, struck Hanuman's jaw during his childhood. The child received his name from the Sanskrit words Hanu (jaw) and man (or mant, prominent or disfigured). The name thus means One with prominent or disfigured Jaw. According to another theory, the name Hanuman derives from the protoDravidian word for male monkey (anamandi), which was later Sanskritzed to Hanuman. The original Bullet Space Pen was conceived in July of 1948 by Paul Fisher, who was soon machining a new pen design shaped from solid aluminum. All Fisher Space pens are lifetime guaranteed for quality against all manufacturing defects.

title: Sailor Limited Edition Ganesha Fountain Pen (21k Kop Broad) Black And Gold
description:
The Sailor Pen Company made its Indian debut in 2008 and is now one of the most popular brands of fine writing instruments in the country.

Om Shri Ganeshay Namah is an expression of Sailors gratitude to the Indian people. Melding the rich traditions and cultures of two great and ancient civilisations, Sailor is proud to introduce this limitededition series containing only 108 pieces worldwide. Each numbered makie pen is a tribute to Lord Ganesha and has been signed personally by the artist, master craftsman Isana Kobayashi.

The pen is made of ebonite a lustrous hardrubber like material that is renowned as the worlds oldest resin. Difficult to process, it's a traditional material for fountain pens with excellent ink corrosion resistance. The jetblack colour develops a subtle patina with age. The polished gleam of the beautiful ebonite pen is complimented by the 21k solid gold nib. The KOP nib is one of Sailors most renowned nibs and is prized for its subtle springiness.

The stunning elements on the pen were detailed using Kaga creative makie. The special technique was developed to help express brightness and colour that could not be fully conveyed through traditional makie. This new lacquer art was developed without compromising the artistry and dignity of traditional makie, a revered artform passed down through generations. The artist skilfully created the images through a delicate process using gold, silver and brass powders.

This series is an exclusive SailorWilliam Penn collaboration.

Note: The width of the pens strokes is influenced by the style of the writer and pressure applied. We will not be able to accept any exchanges or returns because of the customer's personal preferences though a customers personal nib preference may be accommodated on a chargeable basis.

title: Fisher Space Cerakote Cap-o-matic Ballpoint Pen - Earth Brown
description:
The Earth Brown CapOMatic Space Pen, finished in Cerakote, is one of the most durable retractable pens offered by Fisher. Its quick retraction and singlehanded activation make it an ideal writing tool for trade professionals who need to write in tough spots, such as upside down, while hanging off a ladder, or sliding under a vehicle to take measurements.

Several models of pens are considered the backbone of Fisher Space Pen. While the AG7, Bullet, and Shuttle Series pens have always been the stars of the show, the classic CapOMatic Space Pen has truly been the bluecollar workhorse of the bunch. Its singlehanded activation makes this model the pen of choice for construction crews, law enforcement, firefighters, military personnel, first responders, medical professionals, outdoorsmen and women, and anyone who demands dependability from their writing instrument.

The creation of the CapOMatic allowed Fisher Space Pen to provide the same technology used by astronauts with singlehanded activation at an affordable price. This pen line uses cap activation to extend and retract the point, and it carries a pressurized PRstyle ink refill cartridge.

The pen offers all the unique capabilities synonymous with Fisher products, including writing upside down at any angle, underwater, through grease, in extreme temperatures ranging from 30 to +250 degrees F, on almost any surface, in the gravityfree vacuum of space, and it lasts three times longer than an average pen.

All Fisher Space Pens are lifetime guaranteed for quality against all manufacturing defects.

title: Sailor Gift Set Solar Term 'fuki' Professional Gear Slim Fountain Pen (14k Medium) With 20 Ml Shikiori Ink Bottle - Green With Gold Trims
description:
Presented in a beautiful gift box, complemented by an ink in a matching hue, Sailor's Solar Term Collection draws inspiration from changing of the four seasons. The Professional Gear Slim pens are made exclusively in Sailor's factory in Hiroshima, Japan, utilising the finest available materials. Hagi: The beans of the Hagi plant, integral to the Japanese sweet 'Ohagi,' are believed to repel malevolent spirits. This limited edition Sailor Professional Gear Fountain Pen signifies the Autumn Equinox, its colour echoing the gentle pastel pink shades of the Bush Clover flower, known as "Hagi."

description: The original Sheaffer clickable clip is back! The popular Sheaffer invention has been revived with the Reminder ballpoint pen. A master of design ingenuity, it features the Sheaffer clickable clip that was first introduced in the 1960s. Simply click the bottom of the clip to propel and activate the ballpoint, and click the top when you are finished writing to lock the tip into the retracted position. The smart design prevents the clip from attaching to a pocket, lapel or sheets of paper whenever the writing tip is activated, guarding against contact with even a hint of ink reminding you to click it before you clip it.

title: Montblanc 128379 Meisterstück Legrand 'around The World In 80 Days' Rollerball Pen - Anthracite With Gold Trims
description:
The Meisterstück 'Around The World In 80 Days' collection is inspired by the famous adventure novel by Jules Verne. The collection includes the LeGrand Rollerball pen, which is crafted with anthracite precious resin. This particular pen draws inspiration from the second leg of the journey, which takes the main characters from Bombay to Yokohama.

On the cap of the pen, you can find a cartouche featuring a depiction of a majestic elephant, symbolising the mode of transportation used during this part of the adventure. The clip of the pen is adorned with a red lacquered diamond card suit. Additionally, the cone of the pen is intricately engraved with a pattern inspired by Princess Aouda's jewellery and the card suits. This design represents Mr. Fogg's wager to complete the entire journey in 80 days.

The cap top is embossed with the length of the journey, 25 days from Bombay to Yokohama and 80 days in total. These details and design elements come together to create a pen that captures the spirit and essence of the adventure described in Jules Verne's novel.

title: Sailor Arita Yaki 400 Years Anniversary Arabesque Fountain Pen (21k Fine) - Blue With Gold Trims
description:
The Sailor Arita 400 Years Anniversary Blue Arabesque with Gold Trim 21K F FP is a result of a meticulous collaboration with renowned artisans from "Koransha" and the esteemed "Genemon kiln" of Arita porcelain. Crafted over two years, this writing instrument embodies the rich 400year tradition of Arita porcelain. The Genemon kiln, with a venerable history spanning 250 years, meticulously preserves the timehonored traditions of 'Old Imari,' employing expert techniques in handforming and painting porcelain.

The Arita porcelain fountain pen, taking about two years to complete, stands as a highly regarded writing instrument. It not only delivers a profound and luxurious feel but also allows enthusiasts to thoroughly savour the exquisite texture of Arita porcelain.

The limitededition Blue Arabesque Fountain Pen is distinguished by its exquisite arabesque pattern and the intricate Dami technique. Each pen is crafted to order, showcasing the culmination of creativity and meticulous effort from the entire kiln, ensuring a writing instrument that is not just functional but a true work of art.

title: Sailor Arita Yaki 400 Years Anniversary Flower & Butterfly Fountain Pen (21k Fine) - Blue With Gold Trims
description:
For over four centuries, Arita porcelain has cherished the rich heritage of craftsmanship dating back to Japan's first porcelain creation in 1616, during the Genna era. In recent times, we've embarked on a journey to embrace new horizons, seeking to unfold fresh chapters of innovation and potential. In 2007, a remarkable collaboration between our fountain pen and esteemed artisans from "Koransha" and "Genemon kiln" of Arita porcelain, orchestrated by "Saga Cardboard Shokai," the Arita porcelain fountain pen series came to life.

Presenting the enchanting Flower and Butterfly motif, a timeless chintz pattern cherished by generations of Japanese enthusiasts. This design resonates with the allure of distant lands, evoking the exoticism of ethnic patterns through a captivating palette of colors. Each pen features a 21K Gold nib with Gold plating, comes with both a Converter and Cartridge functionalities. Crafted from Arita Yaki porcelain, the cap, barrel, and cap top exude elegance, while the gripping section boasts Brass with Gold plating, ensuring a harmonious blend of sophistication and functionality.

Crafted from Arita Yaki porcelain, the cap, barrel, and cap top exude elegance, while the gripping section boasts Brass with Rhodium plating, ensuring a harmonious blend of sophistication and functionality.

description:

Crafted using the traditional Ishimenuri lacquer technique, these oversized pens mirror Sailor's 1911 King of Pen dimensions. IroMiyabi translates to "beautiful colors," embodying beauty and grace.

Created by urushi master Isana Kobayashi in Kaga City, Japan, these pens feature layers of urushi over ebonite, giving a light feel to their large size.

Notably, in May 2023, these pens were presented to G7 leaders at the G7 Hiroshima Summit, each engraved with the initials of the respective leaders, showcasing Japan's craftsmanship.

title: Sailor Limited Edition Wajima Bijou Ii Fountain Pen (21k Fine) - Red With Gold Trims
description:
Introducing the Sailor Wajima Bijou fountain pen, a sophisticated gem meticulously designed to showcase the skilled handwork of craftsmen and the exquisite beauty of jewelry. This masterpiece pays homage to the traditional Japanese art of "Wajimanuri," a lacquerware technique with roots dating back to the Heianera in Wajimacity, Ishikawa Prefecture.

Sailor's commitment to honoring the craftsmanship of Wajimanuri makie artisans is evident in the intricate design of the Wajima Bijou fountain pen, featuring a border pattern on the barrel, cap, and bottom of the barrel adorned with colors representing precious jewels and motherofpearl. Each jewel stone incorporated into the pen carries its unique significance, making the Wajima Bijou a fusion of artistic craftsmanship and meaningful design inspired by the concept of jewelry, with "Bijou" translating to jewel in French.

This exclusive fountain pen celebrates the rich heritage of Japanese arts and crafts, particularly the renowned Urushinuri technique, and invites enthusiasts to appreciate the cultural significance and meticulous detailing embodied in the Wajima Bijou collection.

title: Montblanc 131344 Meisterstück The Original Collection Ballpoint Pen - Green With Gold Trims
description:
Since its introduction in 1924, the Montblanc Meisterstück has surpassed its status as a mere writing tool, evolving into a symbol of sophistication and personal expression. Whether used for crafting romantic prose or signing significant historical documents, the Meisterstück has woven itself into the fabric of history, leaving an enduring legacy.

The collection takes cues from early, previously unreleased prototypes, as well as design elements present in the earliest Meisterstück editions, capturing the essence of its inception and infusing it with a contemporary twist. Meticulously crafted from luxurious dark green resin, the cap boasts a flowing pattern reminiscent of early designs, symbolizing the fluidity of ink on paper, elegantly complemented by goldcoated accents. The clip pays homage to the vintage clip shapes found in the original Meisterstücks, evoking a nostalgic sentiment. Upon closer examination, one can spot the iconic Meisterstück logo, a hallmark of exceptional quality since its inception. To mark this jubilee edition, a special cap ring is adorned with the years "1924" and "2024." This writing instrument is available as a fountain pen and ballpoint pen. Here's to another century of excellence with Meisterstück!

title: Montblanc 129334 Special Edition Muhammad Ali Rollerball Pen - Black With Gold Trims
description:
Few athletes are revered and commemorated like Muhammad Ali, the threetime Heavyweight Champion of the world, whose iconic moments in sports and civil rights activism cemented his status as one of the most influential figures of the 20th century. Ali's journey as an athlete began with a bang, claiming the Heavyweight Champion title at the tender age of 22, captivating the world with his remarkable blend of strength, skill, and charisma. Yet, it was his profound impact beyond the ring that truly defined his legacy.

A rollerball that is meticulously crafted, the tribute to Ali embodies both his sporting prowess and his humanitarian spirit. The precious Black resin of the pen's cap evokes the image of a punching bag, while the barrel's design mirrors the tape boxers use to wrap their hands before a match. From Ali's famous catchphrase "Float like a Butterfly, sting like a bee" to symbolic engravings representing his victories, each element pays homage to his indelible mark on both sports history and the fight for justice. The inclusion of intricate details, such as his triumph at the 1960 Olympics and his first heavyweight world championship in 1964, along with the cap ring commemorating his victorious seventhround technical knockout, serves as a testament to his enduring legacy. And in a fitting tribute to his inaugural title, the Montblanc emblem is adorned with a "1," while the clip, fashioned after a championship belt, proudly bears his name, immortalizing his impact both inside and outside the ring.

Since its introduction in 1924, the Montblanc Meisterstück has surpassed its status as a mere writing tool, evolving into a symbol of sophistication and personal expression. Whether used for crafting romantic prose or signing significant historical documents, the Meisterstück has woven itself into the fabric of history, leaving an enduring legacy.

The collection takes cues from early, previously unreleased prototypes, as well as design elements present in the earliest Meisterstück editions, capturing the essence of its inception and infusing it with a contemporary twist. Meticulously crafted from luxurious dark green resin, the cap boasts a flowing pattern reminiscent of early designs, symbolizing the fluidity of ink on paper, elegantly complemented by goldcoated accents. The clip pays homage to the vintage clip shapes found in the original Meisterstücks, evoking a nostalgic sentiment. Upon closer examination, one can spot the iconic Meisterstück logo, a hallmark of exceptional quality since its inception. To mark this jubilee edition, a special cap ring is adorned with the years "1924" and "2024." The nib in this edition has 100 inscribed on it. Here's to another century of excellence with Meisterstück!

title: Montblanc 131348 Meisterstück The Origin Collection Doue Midsize Ballpoint Pen - Blue With Platinum Trims
description:
Montblanc's Meisterstück has been celebrated as the finest writing instrument since 1924, representing elegant taste and personal expression. Whether used to write a personalised letters or sign document or just jot down everyday thoughts, the Meisterstück has made a lasting impact on history.

To celebrate this series, Montblanc created the Origin collection, inspired by designs and features from the original Meisterstück editions. The cap's intricate pattern, coated with blue lacquer and platinum, is based on an old, unreleased design from the Art Déco period. The clip and the original Meisterstück logo on the cap bring a nostalgic touch. This special edition also features a cap ring with the years 1924 and 2024. Here’s to another 100 years of excellence with Meisterstück!

title: Montblanc 131365 Meisterstuck The Olympic Heritage Collection Chamonix 1924 Classic Ballpoint Pen - Grey With Platinum Trims
description:
To mark the 100th anniversary of the Meisterstück in 2024, Montblanc has crafted a unique collection inspired by the 1924 Olympic Winter Games in Chamonix. The year 1924 is significant for Montblanc as it saw the introduction of the Meisterstück, a timeless masterpiece, and the first Winter Olympics held at the base of Mont Blanc. Both Montblanc and the 1924 Olympics symbolize a quest for excellence, showcasing the finest craftsmanship and athletic prowess.

The Classique edition is made with precious resin in a bluegrey hue, echoing the official color of the Winter Games. The cap top ring features the Olympic Rings and a wreath of leaves, reminiscent of the laurel crowns awarded to ancient Olympic champions. The cap itself is engraved with "Olympic Games Chamonix 1924," inspired by the official Games report. The anniversary cap ring displays the years "1924" and "2024," highlighting the importance of both dates. Topping off the edition is the Montblanc emblem set in coralcoloured resin, the brand's signature shade.

title: Montblanc 130674 Writer's Edition Jane Austen Ballpoint Pen - Blue Jean With Gold Trims
description:
To honour one of English literature's most beloved authors Jane Austen, Montblanc has designed the Writers Edition Homage to Jane Austen. This edition reflects the Regency era, a time when grand parties at country estates were key for socializing and forming marriage alliances. The elegant sandstonegrey resin barrel is adorned with fluting reminiscent of classical columns and Jane Austen's signature. The greyblue cap is inspired by the doublecollared coats worn by gentlemen like Mr. Darcy in Pride and Prejudice. Goldcoated rings and platinumplated fittings complete the design.

The cap ring features the Roman numerals XLIII, marking the chapter where Elizabeth Bennet first sees Mr. Darcy's estate. The cap top is inscribed with "By a Lady," referencing the title page of Sense and Sensibility, published in 1811, along with the Montblanc emblem. The writing instrument's silhouette resembles a wax seal stamp, and the clip, shaped like a braided cord with a drawstring closure, mimics the reticules used by women in the 1800s. The only known silhouette of Jane Austen, capturing her delicate features, is engraved on the handcrafted, rhodiumcoated solid gold nib.

title: Sheaffer Superbook Mini 8000mah Power Bank Organizer - Grey
description:
Why carry a separate notepad, pen, power bank and cardholder, when you can have them all in one?

Sheaffer Superbook is just that a marvelously versatile quiver for everything you need to be productive, connected and organized. That means no more fumbling at airport security, no more scampering for things you've forgotten, and no more messy bags to mine for what you need. The organizer has a business card holder, a utility pouch, three card slots, an ID window and a handy slipin pocket that can hold your passport/boarding pass on the inner panels, and a pen holder on the spine. It contains two replaceable slim Sheaffer Quikfills. The utilitarian backpouch on the outside can be used to carry folded documents, a newspaper or an additional slim notebook. The organizer comes in a stylish gift box that can be used to archive and store Quikfills and other slim notebooks of a similar size.
